# Integrate Health Records

The calls themselves: where they live, what they need in their headers, every operation, and one request written out in full.

## Hosts

- `https://api.eka.care` Production server
- `https://api.dev.eka.care` Development server
- `https://api.eka.care`
- `https://api.dev.eka.care`

## Auth and headers

Get a token first: [Authentication](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/auth/getting-started).

- `auth`: HTTP bearer. Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
- `bearerAuth`: HTTP bearer. Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
- `auth`: API key in the `auth` header.
- `authToken`: HTTP bearer. Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

Headers that some operations require:

- `X-Pt-Id`
- `accept`
- `device-id`

## One request in full

POST /mr/api/v1/docs, from [its page](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/health-records/obtain-authorization).

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.eka.care/mr/api/v1/docs' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -H 'X-Pt-Id: <X-Pt-Id>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
  "batch_request": [
    {
      "dt": "ps",
      "dd_e": 1614556800,
      "tg": [
        "tag1",
        "tag2"
      ],
      "files": [
        {
          "contentType": "image/jpeg",
          "file_size": 110000
        }
      ],
      "document_id": "d1ed9519-d2aa-400b-a572-6e00701b9fb3"
    }
  ]
}'
```
